data.title: From bookings to next week’s session.

steps.d: Each booking brings a skill level. Catch plans the rounds so every match is close and all forty players get about the same time on court.
Players confirm their level at the door. Walk-ins join the next round, not a queue.
Between games, phones buzz with the next court and partner. Scores go in with a tap.
Catch counts every player’s minutes on court. Anyone falling behind goes on next; anyone sitting out is pointed to the lounge, and to someone there to meet.
Final standings go out with the photos. Players who want an easier or tougher session get that invitation next.

data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: No. You bring the courts, at your venue or one you hire. Catch runs the session on them: bookings, levels, rotations, court time and standings.
Which sports does it work for?
Pickleball, padel, badminton and tennis doubles, or anything played in pairs on courts. You set the number of courts and the round length.
What if the levels are uneven?
Catch keeps matches as close as the players allow, and counts court time so nobody sits out more than their share.
Check them in at the door with a level. They join the next round, and court time stays fair.
No. Players book, check in and see their next court in their phone’s browser.
How is this different from Playo?

Playo helps players book courts and find games. Catch helps you run a session for a group: levels, rotations, fair court time and bringing players back. Many hosts book the courts one place and run the night on Catch.
